## Requirement and change

Describe the requirement, behavior change, and any compatibility impact.

## Evidence

List commands actually run, outcomes, relevant source revisions, and tests not run. Do not equate record validation with evidence truth or agent-host reliability.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change and pass locally.
- [ ] No real secrets, private requirements, customer data, or unredacted traces are included.
- [ ] Licensing and upstream attribution are preserved.
- [ ] Security/permission boundaries are not weakened.
- [ ] The release allowlist and documentation are updated where necessary.
- [ ] Remaining risks and blocked checks are explicit.
